decisions.reason: The supplement range builds directly on the firm's consumer health formulation, regulatory and pharmacy-channel knowledge, so it can read market feedback and refine the line, even though there is no website evidence for 2020 to 2021.

The skin and hair supplement sits close to the firm's existing supplement brand and pharmacy business, so it can be improved through related knowledge, although the missing visibility after 2019 adds some uncertainty.
As an extension of the established Trivital line, the joint health product draws on strong related knowledge in formulation and marketing, which makes continued refinement feasible.

The OTC triptan is distant from the consumer offer, but the firm's in-house pharmaceutical development, manufacturing and regulatory capabilities let it absorb and apply the relevant knowledge, and it fits the stated push into new consumer health products, though the lack of archived evidence raises the risk.
